notes:
Opportunity: Ironwell builds internal developer tooling (IDE plugins, CI integrations) and wants an on-prem code copilot for their R&D teams. Evaluation is air-gapped: no outbound egress allowed from target cluster. Key ask: packaged, signed installer that can be transferred via secure media and validated with checksums/SBOM.

POC scope (short):
- Run a dev-focused copilot: code completion + streaming suggestions inside VSCode plugin, low latency (developer-perceived sub-150ms per token ideally).
- Model/version pinning: customer must be able to pin specific model binaries (e.g. code-focused 34B or 70B quantized) and rollback easily.
- Offline model updates: signed delta bundles + install script; staff will transfer via SFTP/USB; must have reproducible verification.
- Observability: token-level cost-like metrics, per-route call traces, audit logs for queries (retention 1 year).

Hardware / sizing notes (from SE workshop):
- POC: 2 x A100 80GB or equivalent (4 vGPU setup) to validate interactive latency with a small dev team (10-20 users).
- Prod target (initial): 6-8 x H100 80GB (or equivalent) to support 200-300 monthly active devs with model-pinning + caching.
- Memory heavy: prefer 80GB-class GPUs to allow larger KV cache and multiple pinned variants.

Packaging & ops requirements:
- Deliverables requested: air-gapped tarball (installer.sh), Helm charts with images in an OCI tarball, repo of RPMs/debs, SBOM for all images, signed model artifacts (sha256), installation runbook, offline upgrade playbook.
- KMS: must integrate with customer HSM for key wrapping; if not available, support for offline key import/export flow required.
- Network: customer will provide a private mirror server reachable from install environment. No outbound connections from runtime.

Security feedback (from CISO):
- "We need reproducible builds and a chain-of-trust for models. Can't accept unsigned image updates."
- Requested SOC2-type documentation + penetration test schedule.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- IDE plugin can open streaming suggestions with max cold-start latency < 250ms and steady-state per-token latency < 150ms for common completions.
- Model pinning works end-to-end: deploy a new pinned variant, validate rollback within an hour.
- Offline update process completes without internet and produces identical checksums to source artifacts.
- Basic metrics + audit logs visible in console and retained per policy.

Sales notes / friction points:
- Procurement cycle long (hardware purchase + legal).
- Customer sensitive to export controls for model weights — legal has to sign off on license.
- Price sensitive on ARR but willing to pay for enterprise-grade security and offline updates.

Quoted ask from customer: "We need something we can drop into our air-gapped datacenter and trust — no surprise callbacks to the cloud."

Next actions (short):
- SE to deliver air-gapped artifact package and signed SBOM by 2026-03-15.
- Solutions to draft HSM integration pattern and offline key import doc.
- Schedule 2-day POC install (onsite/remote) tentatively 2026-03-22.
